mapper.select: select q.qual_id, q.qual_name, q.qual_level, q.qual_type, q.validity, q.remind, c.id, c.contractor_id, coalesce(c.check_status, 0) as check_status, c.valid_date, c.remark, c.checker from cbs.t_contractor_qual q left join cbs.t_contractor_qual_check c on c.qual_id = q.qual_id and c.contractor_id = #{contractorId} and c.open_status = true where q.type_id = #{typeId} and q.qual_type = #{qualType} and q.open_status = true and q.is_using = true order by q.create_time

select id, contractor_id, qual_id, qual_type, check_status, valid_date, remark, checker, creator from cbs.t_contractor_qual_check where contractor_id = #{contractorId} and qual_id = #{qualId} and open_status = true
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor_qual_check (id, contractor_id, qual_id, qual_type, check_status, valid_date, remark, checker, check_time, creator, open_status) values (#{p.id}, #{p.contractor_id}, #{p.qual_id}, #{p.qual_type}, coalesce(#{p.check_status}, 0), #{p.valid_date}, #{p.remark}, #{p.checker}, now(), #{p.creator}, true)
mapper.update: update cbs.t_contractor_qual_check set qual_type = coalesce(#{p.qual_type}, qual_type), check_status = coalesce(#{p.check_status}, 0), valid_date = #{p.valid_date}, remark = #{p.remark}, checker = #{p.checker}, check_time = now() where id = #{p.id} and open_status = true
